steps.title: Workflow tabs
steps.text: Interface tour. The tabs at the top lead through the work, left to right, from the project to the report. This tour uses the LBCO example, so every page is filled in.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Save writes the project to its folder.

steps.title: Undo and Redo
steps.text: Undo takes back the last change, and Redo makes it again.

steps.title: Clear
steps.text: Clear closes the project and starts again with nothing loaded.

steps.title: AI assistant
steps.text: The AI assistant answers questions and can work in the app for you.

steps.title: Tooltips
steps.text: This switch turns help tooltips on or off; right-click it for their level and delay.

steps.title: Preferences
steps.text: Preferences hold the choices for the whole app, such as tooltips, colours and the logging level.

steps.title: Home
steps.text: Home: the start page, with the tutorials, the documentation and how to get in touch.

steps.title: Start
steps.text: Start opens the Project page.

steps.title: Open Project
steps.text: Project: what the project is, where it is saved, and the examples and recent projects. Open the Project page with its tab, or press Next.

steps.title: Description
steps.text: The main view shows the project's title, description and authors, as the report will show them.

steps.title: Main tab
steps.text: Main holds the controls used most often on each page.

steps.title: Get started
steps.text: Create a new project, or open one from a folder or a .zip file.

steps.title: Examples
steps.text: Open a built-in example. It stays unsaved until you save it.

steps.title: Recent projects
steps.text: The projects you opened lately, newest first.

steps.title: Extra tab
steps.text: Extra: the format of numbers with a standard uncertainty.

steps.title: Uncertainties
steps.text: How numbers with a standard uncertainty are written in the project and its report.

steps.title: Text tab
steps.text: Text: This page's part of the project as it is saved, ready to edit as text.

steps.title: Apply the text
steps.text: After editing the text, click the check mark to apply it to the project. The box beside it chooses what the tab shows: Editable, the parts you can edit, or Everything, with the measured data and results read-only.

steps.title: Open Structure
steps.text: Structure: the crystal structures, with their symmetry, cell and atoms. Open the Structure page with its tab, or press Next.

steps.title: Structure view
steps.text: The structure view draws the cell and its atoms. Drag to turn it.

steps.title: Main tab
steps.text: Main: what defines the structure.

steps.title: Structures
steps.text: The structures in the project. Add, copy or remove one here.

steps.title: Space group
steps.text: The space group, by its symbol or its number.

steps.title: Cell
steps.text: The cell lengths and angles. Values the symmetry fixes are shown, not typed.

steps.title: Atom sites
steps.text: The atom sites: element, position, occupancy and displacement.

steps.title: Atomic displacements
steps.text: Each site’s displacement: isotropic (B iso) for most sites, or the six anisotropic components for a site given an anisotropic type.

steps.title: Extra tab
steps.text: Extra: scattering lengths, the symmetry operators, the atoms in the cell, bonds and how the view looks.

steps.title: Scattering lengths
steps.text: The scattering lengths of the elements, for the neutron patterns.

steps.title: Symmetry operators
steps.text: The symmetry operators of the space group.

steps.title: Cell atoms
steps.text: Every atom in the cell, as the symmetry places them.

steps.title: Bonds
steps.text: The bond lengths between neighbouring atoms.

steps.title: Appearance
steps.text: How the structure view draws atoms, bonds and the cell.

steps.title: Open Experiment
steps.text: Experiment: the measurements, with their instrument, peak profile and background. Open the Experiment page with its tab, or press Next.

steps.title: Pattern
steps.text: Pattern shows the measured pattern and the one the model calculates.

steps.title: Main tab
steps.text: Main: what defines the experiment.

steps.title: Experiments
steps.text: The experiments in the project. Add one from a measured data file.

steps.title: Background
steps.text: The background under the peaks.

steps.title: Instrument
steps.text: The instrument, such as the wavelength and the zero shift.

steps.title: Peak profile
steps.text: The peak profile: how the shape and width of the peaks change across the pattern.

steps.title: Excluded regions
steps.text: Parts of the pattern left out of the fit.

steps.title: Linked structures
steps.text: The structures that contribute to this pattern, each with its scale.

steps.title: Extra tab
steps.text: Extra: background estimation, the peak cutoff, absorption, preferred orientation, the radiation, the measured data and the reflections.

steps.title: Background estimate
steps.text: How the background is estimated from the measured pattern.

steps.title: Peak cutoff
steps.text: The peak cutoff: how far from its centre each peak is calculated, in peak widths.

steps.title: Absorption
steps.text: Absorption by the sample.

steps.title: Preferred orientation
steps.text: Preferred orientation of the crystallites.

steps.title: Scattering source
steps.text: The radiation’s own settings: for neutrons, the table of scattering lengths the calculation uses.

steps.title: Measured data
steps.text: The measured points: position, intensity and uncertainty.

steps.title: Reflections
steps.text: The reflections the structure gives in this pattern.

steps.title: Open Analysis
steps.text: Analysis: choose what the fit may change, run the fit and look at the result. Open the Analysis page with its tab, or press Next.

steps.title: Main tab
steps.text: Main: the parameters.

steps.title: Parameters
steps.text: Every parameter, with its value and uncertainty. Tick free for the ones the fit may change.

steps.title: Datablock filter
steps.text: Show the parameters of all blocks, or only of one structure or experiment.

steps.title: Category filter
steps.text: Show the parameters of one category, such as the cell or the atom sites.

steps.title: Free filter
steps.text: Show all parameters, only the free ones, only the fixed ones, or those that cannot be fitted.

steps.title: Name filter
steps.text: Type part of a name to list only the parameters whose names contain it.

steps.title: Clear filters
steps.text: Clear all filters, to list every parameter again.

steps.title: Fit
steps.text: Start the fit: click Fit, or press Next. The status bar follows it while it runs.

steps.title: Fit results
steps.text: The fit's results: its status, the reduced chi-squared and the R values of each dataset. Close them with OK.

steps.title: Correlations
steps.text: Correlations, filled by the fit: how strongly the fitted parameters depend on each other.

steps.title: Stacked and Map
steps.text: Stacked and Map draw the fits of several patterns together, one above another and as a colour map. They become available with a scan or a joint fit of several experiments.

steps.title: Extra tab
steps.text: Extra: the minimizer, the fitting mode, aliases and constraints.

steps.title: Minimizer
steps.text: The minimizer that runs the fit, and its settings.

steps.title: Fitting mode
steps.text: Fit one experiment, several together, or a scan.

steps.title: Aliases
steps.text: Short names for parameters, for constraints to use.

steps.title: Constraints
steps.text: Constraints that tie a parameter to others.

steps.title: Settings tab
steps.text: Settings: which parameters the table lists, and how often a scan redraws the pattern.

steps.title: Shown parameters
steps.text: Which parameters the table lists.

steps.title: Pattern updates
steps.text: How often a scan redraws the pattern.

steps.title: Open Report
steps.text: Report: a summary of the fitted model. Open the Report page with its tab, or press Next.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: The report as it will be saved.

steps.title: Main tab
steps.text: Main: what goes into the report, and how it is saved.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: Save the report as HTML, PDF or CIF.

steps.title: Contents
steps.text: Choose the parts the report shows.

steps.title: Text tab
steps.text: Text: the report's saved settings, as text.
